reasoning: I treated the sealed 'defining coefficients' as the signature of a fixed linear recurrence and spent 8 samples on n=1..8 to identify it rather than testing points. Over GF(3301) the terms 51, 309, 1971, 3126, 2305, 546, 884, 1038 are consistent with a unique order-2 recurrence f(n+2) = 11*f(n+1) - 28*f(n) (mod 3301); order 1 is inconsistent, and orders 3 and 4 only reproduce the order-2 solution with leading coefficient zero, so order 2 is minimal. The fit is over-determined: 2 unknowns constrained by 6 equations, all satisfied. Its characteristic polynomial x^2 - 11x + 28 factors as (x-4)(x-7), giving the closed form f(n) = 4*4^n + 5*7^n (mod 3301). I then computed all 600 domain values offline, by both the closed form and by iterating the recurrence independently (the two agree at every n in [1,600]), and found no n with f(n) == 1436. Because 4 and 7 have multiplicative orders 330 and 550 mod 3301, the sequence is purely periodic with period 1650; an exhaustive check over one full period shows 1436 is not in the image of f at all, so this is not a boundary trap with a witness sitting just outside [1,600]. To guard against the model being fitted to a prefix and deviating later, I spent 8 further samples at spread points 50, 137, 213, 300, 377, 451, 528 and 600, including the upper domain endpoint; all 8 matched the model exactly. 16 of 16 metered observations agree with the model. LIMITATION, stated plainly: this is not a proof over the sealed object. The claim is decided by a model inferred from 16 metered observations, not by an exhaustive check of the 600 sealed values; an adversarially planted single-point deviation at one of the 584 unobserved n could in principle place a 1436 that this route would miss. That residual is what the confidence below prices, and it is not reducible within the 120-call cap, since exhausting the domain costs 600.
route_taken: Bought structure instead of coverage: 8 samples to identify and over-determine the order-2 recurrence mod 3301, closed-form extrapolation to all 600 points offline, then 8 spread confirmation samples including the endpoint n=600 -- chosen over 'range 1 600' (costs 600, unaffordable at a 120 cap) and over blind point-by-point evaluate (covers at most 120/600 of the domain and would have forced UNRESOLVED).
what_would_resolve_it: An exhaustive metered pass over the whole domain (range 1 600, cost 600) would settle it outright, or a budget-cheap disclosure of the recurrence order/coefficients so the extrapolation rests on the generator rather than on an inferred fit. Failing either, a 'range' sweep of the 584 unobserved points would close the planted-deviation gap; artifacts: model_check.py and model_check.out in this directory.
